properties.name: CompressorCapacity
properties.definition: The product of the  ideal capacity and the overall volumetric efficiency of the compressor.

properties.name: EnergyEfficiencyRatio
properties.definition: Energy efficiency ratio (EER).

properties.name: CoefficientOfPerformance
properties.definition:
The Coefficient of performance (COP) is the ratio of heat removed to energy input.
The energy input may be obtained by multiplying
Pset_DistributionPortPHistoryGas.FlowRate on the 'Fuel' port of the IfcChiller by Pset_MaterialFuel.LowerHeatingValue.
The IfcDistributionPort for fuel has an associated IfcMaterial with fuel properties and is assigned to an IfcPerformanceHistory object nested within this IfcPerformanceHistory object.

properties.name: VolumetricEfficiency
properties.definition: Ratio of the actual volume of gas entering the compressor to the theoretical displacement of the compressor.

properties.name: CompressionEfficiency
properties.definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to the work delivered to the gas within the compression volume (as obtained by measurement).

properties.name: MechanicalEfficiency
properties.definition:
The objects operational mechanical efficiency.

Ratio of the work (as measured) delivered to the gas to the work input to the compressor shaft.

properties.name: IsentropicEfficiency
properties.definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to work input to the compressor shaft.

properties.name: CompressorTotalEfficiency
properties.definition: Ratio of the thermal cooling capacity to electrical input.

properties.name: ShaftPower
properties.definition: The actual shaft power input to the compressor.

properties.name: InputPower
properties.definition: Input power to the compressor motor.

properties.name: LubricantPumpHeatGain
properties.definition: Lubricant pump heat gain.

properties.name: FrictionHeatGain
properties.definition: Friction heat gain.

properties.name: CompressorTotalHeatGain
properties.definition: Compressor total heat gain.

properties.name: FullLoadRatio
properties.definition: Ratio of actual power to full load power as a quadratic function of part load, at certain condensing and evaporating temperature, FracFullLoadPower = f ( PartLoadRatio).

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: PowerSource
properties.definition: Type of power driving the compressor.

properties.name: RefrigerantClass
properties.definition:
Refrigerant class used by the object.
CFC: Chlorofluorocarbons.
HCFC: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons.
HFC: Hydrofluorocarbons.

properties.name: MinimumPartLoadRatio
properties.definition: Minimum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

properties.name: MaximumPartLoadRatio
properties.definition: Maximum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

properties.name: CompressorSpeed
properties.definition: Compressor speed.

properties.name: NominalCapacity
properties.definition:
The total nominal or volumetric capacity of the object.

Compressor nameplate capacity.

properties.name: IdealCapacity
properties.definition: Compressor capacity under ideal conditions.

properties.name: IdealShaftPower
properties.definition: Compressor shaft power under ideal conditions.

properties.name: HasHotGasBypass
properties.definition: Whether or not hot gas bypass is provided for the compressor. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

properties.name: ImpellerDiameter
properties.definition: Diameter of object - used to scale performance of geometrically similar objects.

propertySets.name: Qto_CompressorBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of compressors.
